The Guide

Before you dive in…

What this is. The Guide pairs practical, no-fluff guides with real business tools — client trackers, schedulers, goal tracking — built specifically for whatever kind of work you actually do.

Why we built it. Good guidance and good tools shouldn't only be available to people who can afford an expensive course or an agency. This is meant to be the thing you actually open daily, not a course you buy and forget.

What's next. A couple of quick questions so we can set up your home screen around what you're actually working on. Takes about 20 seconds — or skip it entirely, your call.

The Guide

Pick everything that applies — we'll set your home screen up around it. You can always change this later.

Your data

Select all and copy — this is a prototype so there's no server-side file download.

Import data

Paste CSV in the same format as an export from this app (Niche,Type,Field1,Field2,Field3). This adds to your existing data — it won't remove anything.

Your full backup

Everything in your account — guides completed, tools, streak, bookmarks, chapter picks. Save this text somewhere safe; anyone with it could restore it into any account.

Restore from backup

This replaces everything in your current account — guides, tools, streak, bookmarks — with what's in the backup. This can't be undone. Paste your backup JSON below.
